articles.title: Channel smuggling gangs resort to 'mega-dinghies' as crackdown limits small boat supply
articles.description: Once-rival criminal groups are being forced to work together because of a shortage of small boats, a BBC investigation has found.

articles.title: Watch: Drop in small boats crossings forces smugglers to adapt
articles.description: A BBC investigation has found smuggling gangs are running low on small boats, forcing rival gangs to work together and load more migrants on larger boats.

articles.title: UN warns of 'supersized' El Niño as countries prepare for impact
articles.description: The WMO has warned that the natural weather phenomenon could bring disruption to global economies.

articles.title: King hails 'unprecedented' Bayeux Tapestry exhibition in London
articles.description: British and French leaders will be at the British Museum to see the exhibition of the historic Bayeux Tapestry.
